topic_details.drug_screen: jerry reports easy sobriety, no urges, no drinking, only weird non-drinking dreams, and no prescription medications.
topic_details.appointments_scheduling: they switch from weekly to every-other-week check-ins scheduled two weeks at a time, next appointment pushed to the 21st at 6:30, with email at the start of each week for the off-week.
topic_details.community_service: officer will track 40 hours of community service with no rush, likely started after jail time is done, aiming to finish before august.
topic_details.substance_evaluation: officer notes jerry is good on his substance abuse evaluation per kyle and completed his impact panels, to be forwarded/scanned to his probation officer amber sijin whom he meets today at 7 or 8.
topic_details.work_plumbing: jerry runs his own fencing company working monday through saturday 7 to 6, staying busy, and his son started working with him about a week ago.
topic_details.incentive_time: jerry has incentive time to schedule, plans four hours tomorrow 6-10 at his girlfriend's, keeps six hours left, can visit parents sunday 6-8 after jail, must save receipts, and cannot go to bars, clubs, strip clubs, or casinos.
topic_details.location_monitoring: they review last week's locations which were everywhere for the job; girlfriend's address is 1502 murphy landing drive indianapolis 46207 and parents' at 5890 mcfarland; control room called noting robert again, and a field officer stopped by.
topic_details.family_support: jerry reports family is doing okay, waiting on his pass, his dad is not a phone person, and he has a good support system in place for the most part.
